title: Course Preview Round 8 | EWS Finale Ligure ITA 2017
description: It's the final EWS race of the year and it's back to Finale Ligure to find the 2017 World Champions. Ric McLaughlin and Enrico Guala head high into the Ligurian hills to find out what lies in store for the racers this weekend for the very last race of the season.
author: Pinkbike
